title: Backbone-Informed Adaptation after EEG Pretraining: A Capacity-Controlled Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.07192v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models learn representations that combine information across channels and time. This structure motivates adapters that model the same relationships during downstream learning. However, it is not clear whether such a design outperforms other candidate adapters. Moreover, in order to arrive at a fair comparison between candidate adapters, we also need to consider their trainable parameters. Here, we ask whether a backbone-informed (native) adapter makes better use of a given capacity by comparing it against a token-wise multilayer perceptron control that transforms each feature vector independently. We approximately match their trainable parameter counts and keep the pretrained encoder fixed. Across two EEG foundation models and tasks covering emotion recognition, sleep staging, and EEG event classification, the native adapter shows no consistent advantage. translated_title: 基于主干信息的EEG预训练后适配：一项参数容量对照研究
translated_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）基础模型学习跨通道和时间融合信息的表征，这一结构启发人们设计在下游学习中建模同样关系的适配器。然而，这种设计是否优于其他候选适配器尚不明确；此外，为了在候选适配器之间进行公平比较，还必须考虑它们的可训练参数数量。本文通过将基于主干信息（原生）的适配器与独立变换每个特征向量的逐token多层感知机对照方法进行比较，探究前者是否能更好地利用给定的参数容量。我们近似匹配两者的可训练参数数量，并保持预训练编码器冻结不变。在两个EEG基础模型以及涵盖情绪识别、睡眠分期和EEG事件分类的任务上，原生适配器并未表现出一致的优势。对于其中一个主干网络，两者之间的差异……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 在参数量匹配、容量受控的公平比较下，基于主干结构设计的适配器相较于简单的逐token多层感知机适配器，在多个EEG基础模型和下游任务上并未表现出一致优势。
en_tdlr: Under a parameter-matched, capacity-controlled comparison, the backbone-informed (native) adapter shows no consistent advantage over a simple token-wise MLP adapter across two EEG foundation models and multiple downstream tasks.
